summary: Elemental Royalty filed a 6-K attaching a Canadian material change report confirming completion of its acquisition of all outstanding Vizsla Royalties shares via a court-approved British Columbia plan of arrangement, effective September 14, 2026, under a May 13, 2026 arrangement agreement. Vizsla Royalties holders elected 0.15 Elemental shares, C$4.13 cash, or C$1.03 cash plus 0.1125 shares, prorated to a roughly C$82 million cash cap. Elemental paid about C$82 million cash and issued 8,105,440 shares; former Vizsla holders own roughly 11.19% of Elemental. The deal adds uncapped 2.0%-3.5% Panuco silver-gold NSRs.
